subject.title: Feature request: config option to suppress sub-agent announce

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101248 expand `announceTarget` to include `skip`, or should deterministic suppression remain a separate narrow API?
rationale: The source gap and internal implementation seam are clear, but maintainers must choose a durable public contract that coordinates suppression with the active parent-routing proposal and avoids unnecessary config proliferation.

options.title: Add skip to announceTarget
options.body: Extend the active routing contract to `channel | parent | skip` and keep this issue open until a viable implementation merges.

options.title: Add separate per-spawn skip
options.body: Expose a narrow suppression parameter mapped to the existing no-delivery lifecycle while leaving parent routing independent.

options.title: Keep sentinel-only behavior
options.body: Decline new public surface and continue requiring exact model-output tokens for suppression.

recommendation.title: Add skip to announceTarget
recommendation.body: Extend the active routing contract to `channel | parent | skip` and keep this issue open until a viable implementation merges.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and repeatedly refactored the public spawn and announce lifecycle that owns this product contract.
